Messages.Author: Jason Bell
Messages.Body:
Can Daring the Dawn be used in response to an
attempt to block?

Daring the Dawn (Fortitude action modifier)
Vampires cannot block this action
I: This vampire takes 2 aggrivated damage
(not preventable) after the action is
complete
S: As above, but this acting vampire
takes 1 aggrivated damage

- Jason Bell
